char_1036_fang2.reason: Initial DP Cost runtime_cost is a generic card-level field with no original character/template binding to prove first-deployment versus redeployment ordering. Its native C# card dispatcher is unrecovered. Both exact skills, original models and withdraw-one-shot card talent are retained here for later resolution; operator is not enabled in the regular-stage registry.

interpretations: Both selected skills and promotion/potential talent candidates are implemented for Grani, Elysium, Wild Mane and Kestrel. Optional modules and Tales Within the Sand resource-backpack effects are not applied to ordinary stages. Fang the Fire-Sharpened is explicitly deferred instead of silently omitting her unresolved initial-cost talent.

Card templates prove profession/scope/lifetime and additive values: Elysium sniper HOLD_BY_BUFF; Wild Mane in-hand guards UNTIL_NEXT_SPAWN with per-card max1/5 and E1 CheckBuildCnt<=1. Runtime applies these card additions after the existing normal redeploy multiplier/floor. Native C# calculation/rounding order is not recovered; this composition is an explicit implementation interpretation. Wild Mane in-hand maps to an undeployed, redeploy-ready bench card; a cooling-down guard is excluded until it returns to hand.

Grani S2 attacks only source blocked enemies (selector postFilter4, limitedMaxTargetNumToBlockedCnt1), with all blocked targets receiving one physical hit. Original alternate Attack has empty animKey and Skill_End escapeTime.333; Skill_Loop OnAttack.3 is mapped to attack release while original Skill_Begin/Loop/End are cosmetic mode animation. Native FSM/start/loop dispatch remains unrecovered.

Elysium S1 uses exact character-table override skchr_elysm_1. Both channels apply native final block scaler0 and disarm, produce first DP after the selected full interval, and continue DP during ordinary control. Elysium S2 snapshot-selects the nearest selected max_target living non-disappeared enemies in source x-2, including air/stealth/target-free units per ALL/ignoreTargetFree1. Selector postFilter24 execution is unrecovered; nearest-distance then spawn-order ties and excluding physically hidden/disappeared units are explicit interpretations. Once locked, moving out of range does not remove DEF/MOVE_SPEED final scalers or reveal; source-owned buffs expire at skill end and original .25s source-alive poll cleans up after retreat.

Grani Physical Dodge and Elysium skill ASPD auras retain native purposeMask0 and recorded ignoreHealFree flags, include eligible unhealable recipients and own only their own effects. Continuous target-free/isolation eligibility follows each recorded validator. Elysium deck cost persists while deployed, independent of skill activity.

Wild Mane S1 is the source deploy-time finite-duration ASPD buff, resetting on each deployment. S2 normal attack is replaced by Skill_2 OnAttack.5 with uncapped animation scaling and source directional knockback. knockback[dir] source decreaseForceLevelWhenNotInDirection2 uses the shared directional primitive, which applies its existing off-axis/near-distance two-level correction exactly once. Original Unity continuous displacement remains unrecovered. Shared weight/wall/pit displacement is retained.

Kestrel crit Dice is bound to ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE, rolled separately for each physical attack damage instance before DEF, and uses only selected S2 talent prob_scaler. Source ATK PERCENTAGE/ASPD ADDITION are separate. DP follows periodic_cost first-wait intervals for exactly floor(duration/interval) grants. Source Skill_2_Begin.167 is displayed cosmetically; exact native startup-versus-duration ordering is unrecovered and no extra combat delay is invented.

Normal releases use each original facing OnAttack (including Grani Back Attack_Up) plus native maxAnimScale: Grani cap2, Elysium/Wild Mane uncapped, Kestrel cap1. Original Unity particles, sounds, full native ability/FSM execution and recorded-client frame parity are not claimed.
